title: Index out of bounds panic when playing around with selections.
body:
### Reproduction steps

Have lines of text in the editor. Select some of it. Press `S`. Search some pattern (for example, empty space) and enter. Move around. Crash (sometimes, very rarely, not sure what exaclty has to happen).

I don't know how to properly reproduce this.

### Environment

- Platform: Linux
- Helix version: v0.3.0-23-ge915988 (current master)

<details><summary>~/.cache/helix/helix.log</summary>
